problems.prompt: An electron enters a magnetic field at right angles to it. The field is directed downwards, and the electron moves from left to right. Determine the direction of the magnetic force.
problems.attempt_hint: Yaad rakho, electron ki direction ko reverse karke current banta hai. Fir Left-Hand rule lagao.

solution_steps.narration: Sabse pehle current ki direction theek karni hai. Electron right ja raha hai, matlab current left jayega.
Fleming's Left-Hand rule apply karo. Forefinger downward, middle finger left ki taraf set karo.
Thumb check karo kahan point kar raha hai. Woh seedha paper ke andar ghus raha hoga.

problems.prompt: A positively charged alpha particle projected towards the West is deflected towards the North by a magnetic field. Find the direction of the magnetic field.
problems.attempt_hint: Apne left hand se thumb aur middle finger match karke forefinger ka direction dekho.

solution_steps.narration: Alpha particle positive hota hai, isliye current ki direction seedhi West hi rahegi.
Question keh raha hai ki wo north mud gaya, iska matlab force north ki taraf hai.
Fleming ke Left-Hand rule ke hisab se thumb ko North aur middle finger ko West point karo.
Forefinger apne aap upward disha me point karegi.

problems.prompt: A horizontal power line carries a current from East to West direction. What is the direction of the magnetic field directly below it and directly above it?
problems.attempt_hint: Sirf Right-Hand Thumb Rule lagana hai. Apne right thumb ko West ki taraf point karo.

solution_steps.narration: Current East se West flow ho raha hai, toh right hand ka thumb bhi usi taraf rakhte hain.
Wire ke neeche, ungliyan curl karte waqt South se North ki taraf flow karti hain.
Wire ke upar se jab ungliyan ghoom ke aayengi, toh unka flow North se South jayega.

problems.answer: Below it is towards North; Above it is towards South

problems.prompt: A uniform magnetic field is pointing vertically downwards. A current-carrying conductor is placed horizontally in this field, carrying current from South to North. In which direction will it experience force?
problems.attempt_hint: FBI rule (Fleming's left hand) use karke teeno fingers ko align karo.

solution_steps.narration: Forefinger ko field ki disha mein, yani exactly neeche (downwards) point karo.
Middle finger ko current ki disha mein, yani apni taraf se aage (South to North) point karo.
Apne thumb ko stretch karo to dekho wo kis disha mein push kar raha hai. Woh West ki taraf dikhayega.
